slides: Your muscles don’t grow from wishful thinking.
They respond to a clear, incremental stress.
Add a little weight, a rep, or a range each week.
That tiny extra load forces adaptation.
Consistency + progressive overload = measurable strength.
Decision fatigue is the silent productivity killer.
Every trivial choice drains willpower reserves.
Stack simple habits into a routine to automate them.
When the morning coffee and a 5‑minute stretch are paired, they become one decision.
Free mental bandwidth for the choices that truly matter.
Training hard on an empty sleep bank is self‑sabotage.
Growth hormone spikes during deep sleep, repairing muscle.
Aim for 90 minutes of uninterrupted REM cycles.
Turn off screens, dim lights, and keep the room cool.
Better sleep = stronger gains and clearer focus.
Goals misaligned with values feel like chores.
Values are the compass; goals are the route.
Map each goal to a core value before you start.
When the link is clear, motivation becomes automatic.
Align goals with values and watch effort flow effortlessly.
